environment.storageBoundary: Distinct processes, persistent volumes, owners/LOGIN passwords; same physical host. Anchor not included in application backup.
environment.nativeTools: Existing PG17.6 container clients via protected host UID/GID wrappers, host tar/OpenSSL. No image download/build or package installation.
environment.resourceCaveat: Swap use increased on the host. Samples did not show sustained swap-out/pressure; no claim of continuous zero activity or peak-only attribution.

fixtureBoundaries: Live drain uses two real API child processes, a real PostgreSQL worker claim and processDurableJob executed in the test process; separate existing restart case kills/restarts actual worker children.
Recovery API uses real service routes/store/SQL and explicit synthetic bearer actors. Target API uses actual restricted target issuer/auth logins.
HTTP regression uses real authentication/session/CSRF plus local HTTPS OIDC, memory anchor and authority/binding fixtures; no real IdP or browser.
Recovery Anchor uses real HTTPS and separate restricted PostgreSQL storage. Delay proxy controls only selected synthetic institution requests.
Ledger transaction/receipt and call bindings remain explicit fixtures; no chain/PBX/AI operation asserted.
Backup is application-only and test keys/configuration. No source DB passwords are reused for target app logins.

policy.drain: New general authority writes/consumption/claims blocked across replicas. Existing admitted jobs can settle; terminal/consent withdrawal/cancel/revoke/suspend/cleanup remain eligible during draining.
policy.snapshot: Exclusive shared-writer fence spans exported SQL snapshot; safety writes in this short window return named 503 retry. Failed drain creates no success manifest.
policy.restore: New empty database only, no source object owner replay; authenticated archived key reference checked, target admission fenced and sessions cleared.
policy.activation: Manual source fence/stop confirmation and all target recovery gates ready; no automatic failover or independent verification of a remote source stop.

retention: Only redacted reports/hashes/assertions are shared. Raw DB dumps, encrypted bundles, keys, credentials, sessions and private temporary files are excluded. Existing artifacts are untouched.
